subject: Shared Success Plan: Helix Labs POC - Charter & Benchmarks
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@helixlabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shared Success Plan: Helix Labs POC - Charter & Benchmarks

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for a productive demo last week. As discussed, I’m circulating a draft Shared Success Plan to get alignment on the POC scope, success criteria, and owners so we can hit the targeted close in Q4. Attached: helix_map_draft.xlsx (MAP draft) and benchmark_spec_v1.pdf (measurement plan).

High-level proposal
- Duration: 6 weeks (start: Aug 16)
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference for Helix clinical extraction workflow with production-like latency and accuracy targets

Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: median tail p95 < 350ms for 512-token inference (measured on Helix representative inputs)
- Accuracy: extraction F1 >= 0.92 on the agreed benchmark set
- Cost: inference unit cost within target budget (<= $0.09 per 1k tokens on the projected throughput profile)
- Integration: API-based ingest + KV cache proof-of-concept in Helix dev environment

Benchmark plan (summary)
- Marissa: owns prompt set, golden labels, and eval harness (see attached Spec v1)
- Jonas: owns runtime config, quantization options, and load profile runbook
- Redwood will deliver weekly bench runs and a one-page summary after each run

Roles / RACI (draft)
- Helix PM: Olivia Park — overall review & acceptance sign-off
- Helix Eng: procurement and infra contacts (cc’d procurement as needed)
- Redwood: Irene (POC lead, exec sync), Jonas (serving/runtime lead), Marissa (eval & prompts)

Key dates
- Aug 11: confirm owners & playbook
- Aug 16: POC environment access + baseline run
- Week of Aug 23: first benchmark run and retrospective
- Sep 1: acceptance gate (pass/fail against success criteria)

Please review the attached MAP and the benchmark spec and reply with any edits or missing stakeholders. If the owners above look right, we’ll create a short agenda for a 30-minute kickoff next Tuesday (Aug 10 or Aug 11) — what time window works for you?

Thanks,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM serving

Subject: Re: Shared Success Plan: Helix Labs POC - Charter & Benchmarks

Thanks, Irene — this looks great and aligned with our internal expectations. Quick notes:
- We’ll add one more stakeholder on the Helix side: Samir Desai (platform lead) — I’ll loop him into the kickoff.
- Timeline: procurement will aim to complete review by Aug 30; if we can compress the benchmark cadence slightly (two short runs per week) that helps our cycle.
- Acceptance gate: Helix will sign off on accuracy + integration. For cost we’ll treat it as a commercial discussion post-acceptance (we need a rough estimate during the POC).

Kickoff availability: Tue Aug 10, 10–10:45am PT or Wed Aug 11, 1–1:30pm PT — either works for me.

I uploaded a small dataset sample and a short whitepaper on our extraction constraints: helix_sample_v2.csv (att) and helix-extraction-notes.pdf (att).

Best,
Olivia

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Olivia Park <olivia@helixlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shared Success Plan: Helix Labs POC - Charter & Benchmarks

Looping in some quick operational details so we’re clear on owners and measurements. I’m good with Irene’s draft; minor tweaks below:

Operational responsibilities
- Jonas: infra & serving config, benchmark runs cadence, automated logs + perf traces, provide a baseline config (32GB GPU, q4_0 quant)
- Marissa: prompts, golden label set, eval harness, and regression checks (weekly PR to the bench repo)
- Irene: customer updates, acceptance checklist, executive summary

Bench specifics (to include in Spec v1)
- Input distribution: 70% short clinical notes (<200 tokens), 30% longer batch doc extraction (~600–900 tokens)
- Runs: baseline (no cache), cached prefix run, and steady-state RPS test (target 12 RPS)
- Metrics: latency p50/p95, extraction F1, token cost estimate, memory stability (no >10% VM OOM variance across runs)

My ask for Marissa: can you confirm the golden label format (csv vs ndjson) and the initial prompt family by EOD Tue (Aug 10)? I’ll schedule the infra prep slot for Mon Aug 16 and will post the runbook link here.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0133

1) Irene: send calendar invite + final MAP (Irene to incorporate Samir + procurement items)
